current_evidence: 'The application process' page (updated 09/07/2026) links this PDF as the 'Planning Application Local List' and says the council 'published a revised Local List in July 2026'. Every page of the PDF is headed 'July 2026', and its headings match the '2026 Local List Post Consultation Final' PDF (doc/173658) linked from the consultation page, despite the '2023' in its filename.

issues.detail: The date value (July 2026) is right, but Grokbot based it on PDF CreationDate metadata when the text itself says July 2026. The filename '2023 Local List for website.pdf' is misleading. The same July 2026 list is also published as doc/173658 '2026 Local List Post Consultation Final .pdf'.
issues.evidence: Running header 'July 2026' on every page; application-process page: 'published a revised Local List in July 2026'

issues.detail: The source has about 47 local requirement headings. About 25 are missing from the app-type rows: Agricultural Land Quality Assessment (major development on greenfield land); Air Quality Impact Assessment and Damage Cost Calculation (sites at risk of significant air-quality effects); BNG Statement for exempt sites (non-householder sites exempt from statutory BNG); BREEAM Pre-assessment (non-residential development); Connectivity Statement (all new major development); Climate Change Checklist (new build, or non-residential development adding over 20 sqm, conversions, and householder extensions adding over 20 sqm); Financial Appraisal (where financial reasons justify the proposal, e.g. loss of a rural pub or shop, enabling development, reduced contributions); Flood Risk Assessment (Flood Zones 2/3 including minor development and change of use, Zone 1 sites over 1ha, critical drainage areas); Foul Sewerage Details (non-mains disposal); Green Belt Statement (inappropriate development in the Green Belt); Housing Mix Statement (major residential schemes departing from the SHMA mix); Landscaping Details (full major; indicative masterplan for outline major); Landscape and Visual Impact Appraisal (major development, and non-householder minor development in or visible from the Cotswolds AONB or a Special Landscape Area); Marketing Information (loss of employment or community uses, removal of rural occupancy conditions); Mineral Assessment Report (major non-mineral development in a Mineral Safeguarding Area); Planning Statement (all major); Public Open Space Contributions (10+ dwellings); Retail Impact Assessment (comparison retail over 1,000 sqm or convenience over 2,500 sqm outside Stratford town centre); Self-Build Housing; Solar Farm requirements (glint/glare and decommissioning); Statement of Community Involvement (all major); Street Trees (full and RM major); Sunlight/Daylight Assessment; Surface Water Drainage Strategy (all major, and development in flood-risk areas); Telecommunications Infrastructure Assessment; Topographical Survey (major sites and minor applications with significant level changes); Viability Assessment (where full S106/CIL cannot be met).
issues.evidence: Local List July 2026, requirement table headings e.g. 'Climate Change Checklist (SPD Part V)', 'Connectivity Statement (CS.26)', 'Surface Water Drainage Strategy (CS.4)'

issues.detail: Householder is '(none)', but several local triggers explicitly or practically apply to householder proposals. The Climate Change Checklist is needed for householder extensions adding over 20 sqm. Heritage Statement, Tree Survey/AIA (works affecting trees with stems over 75mm), Flood Risk Assessment (Flood Zones 2/3) and Noise Assessment (e.g. air-conditioning units) can also be triggered.
issues.evidence: Climate Change Checklist trigger includes householder extensions adding over 20 sqm

issues.detail: The list's application-type sections were not mapped. Listed building consent has only a pre-app advice row, but the LBC section requires a Design and Access Statement, Heritage Statement, schedule of works, photographs and detailed drawings, plus a structural report where needed. Works to trees is '(none)', but the TPO section requires a detailed specification and reasons, an arboricultural report for health-related works, and monitoring data for subsidence claims. Lawful development cert is '(none)', but proposed dwelling extensions must include floor and elevation plans; this appears only as a stray tab item. There is also a section on Certificates of Lawfulness for proposed works to a listed building.
issues.evidence: Sections 'Listed Building Consent', 'Works to TPO Trees', 'Lawful Development Certificates'

issues.detail: The only Outline row is 'Construction (Environmental) Management Plan', and its excerpt says outline applications do NOT normally need one. The actual trigger is all major development, development near sensitive uses, or sites with restricted access, and the requirement is missing from Full planning. All other local rows are 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning' without checking the source, even though many triggers (all major, Planning Statement, SCI, Landscaping/indicative masterplan) apply to outline major too. Both 'Pre-application advice' rows (Full and LBC) were placed there only because the advice text mentions listed buildings and major development.
issues.evidence: 'Outline applications will not normally require a Construction Management Plan, which can be required by condition.'

issues.detail: Many excerpts are method or content text, or include page headers, rather than triggers. Agricultural/Rural workers: '2026 Agricultural/ Rural workers Assessment' (header text only; the trigger is rural worker dwellings, tied dwelling extensions and new agricultural, horticultural or forestry businesses). Arboricultural: 'accordance with BS 5837:2012' (the trigger is works affecting trees with stems over 75mm at 1.5m). Contaminated Land: LCRM method text with '10 July 2026' header (the trigger is all major development, plus non-householder sites with industrial, waste or agricultural history). Noise: BS 4142 method with 'July 2026' header. CIL: garbled ('2 July 2026 Fee This can be calculated...'; the CIL Liability Figure is required on every application). S106 Heads of Terms cut off at '1.' (typically six or more houses, and larger commercial schemes). Heritage, Transport and Travel Plan excerpts are fragments ending in 'click here'. Design Code/Masterplan mixes landscaping and tree-RPA text. Ecology is cut off mid-word. 'Ground investigation / Geotechnical' is not a heading in the list.
issues.evidence: Local List July 2026 'When required' column for each item

issues.detail: Several tab items and rows are not requirements. 'The relevant Ward Member ... can see the unredacted Financial Appraisal/FVA, under s100F' is process text and appears twice. Other examples: 'A helpful booklet is Outdoor Advertisements and Signs'; the list of fire hydrants, CCTV and so on followed by 'How to send in your information' and an email address; the pre-application advice and Midlands Advisory Design text; and 'Construction Management Plan template April 2022.pdf Contaminated Land...', which is a heading fragment. The app-type row 'Validation checklist form (completed)' is actually the Climate Change Checklist but has lost its name and trigger. 'Pre-application advice / engagement details' rows are advice, not validation requirements.

Advertisement consent has two rows ('Advertisement drawings / illumination details' and 'Lighting Assessment / External lighting scheme') with the same Lighting Schemes excerpt, including the stray '15 July 2026' page header. The Ward Member FVA sentence is also duplicated in tab_items.

summary: Grokbot links the current July 2026 Stratford Local List, so the date is right but was taken from metadata. It captured fewer than half of the roughly 47 local requirements, left Householder, LBC and Trees without their source-specified items, and many triggers are method text or page-header fragments.
